blocks.title: Create fixed buckets
blocks.text: Each row is a bucket with three available collision slots.

blocks.title: Hash
blocks.text: The same key maps to the same row.

blocks.title: Add
blocks.text: A collision goes into the next free column in that bucket.

blocks.title: Search/remove
blocks.text: Only the calculated bucket is searched. Removal can shift later bucket items left.

blocks.title: Worked example · Add 12, 17 and 22
blocks.text: All three keys hash to bucket 2. 12 % 5 = 2 17 % 5 = 2 22 % 5 = 2
